policy.selfReferenceRule: Serialized ledger/index bytes excluded from membership hashes; explicit schema and report digests cover these artifacts. No hash fixed point.

observations.visibility: Public repository (owner/research metadata); package private flag restricts package publishing, not repository visibility. Local-only app execution is separate.
observations.importHistory: Git account/import history identifies entry points, not authorship, assignment or permission.

art.delivery: protected authorized API; not public static

observations.derivationLimits: Source/master and master-to-input derivations unproven. Script documents PNG-to-WebP mapping, not pixel reproduction. Filename suffix hashes textual shasum output; member SHA-256 hashes raw bytes independently.
observations.fonts: globals.css system sans/monospace stacks; layout.tsx has no font loader. No observed font binaries. System font names do not establish redistribution.
observations.readiness: productionReady: false remains independent of permission; WEST_AREA path and API authorization unchanged.
